title: Multi-head, GQA and RoPE
hook: Split attention into heads, share keys to save memory, and rotate by position so only the gap between tokens counts.

verified.claim: JointAttention has n_kv_heads, n_rep, and one Linear of (n_heads + 2 n_kv_heads) head_dim outputs.
Lumina 2's original size uses 24 heads and 8 key/value heads; the Z image size uses 30 and 30.
rope asserts an even width and uses position times 1/theta^scale.
The attention function rotates q and k, not v.
The lab's rotation matched _apply_rope1 on a CPU, largest gap 2.4e-07.
Same gap gives the same score, and added positions do not.
RoPE and GQA come from those papers, titles from the arXiv API.

unchecked: The speed and quality of GQA against full multi-head are Ainslie et al.'s reported results on text models. We did not measure them, and we did not test image models.
We read the papers' abstracts through the arXiv API and did not rerun anything from them.
